fields.label: Fire Monitor Present
fields.description: Is the fire monitor present during welding activities?

fields.label: Flammables Distance
fields.description: Are flammable materials at a distance of at least 35 feet (11 meters) from the welding site?

fields.label: Preventive Measures Taken
fields.description: If flammable materials cannot be transported, have preventive measures been taken?

fields.label: Fire Protection Available
fields.description: Are fire protection equipment available?

fields.label: Materials Free of Chemicals
fields.description: Are the materials to be welded or will have welding activities free of any chemicals?

fields.label: Eye/Face Protection Used
fields.description: Are the eyes and face protectors (welding glasses, welding face protector) used?

fields.label: Appropriate Filter Used
fields.description: Is the appropriate filter used for welding type and electrode size?

fields.label: Heat Resistant Gloves Used
fields.description: Are protective gloves (heat resistant gloves) used?

fields.label: Safety Shoes Worn
fields.description: Are appropriate safety shoes being worn?

fields.label: Ventilation Available
fields.description: Is the proper ventilation available at the welding site (whether the ventilation is normal or mechanical)?

fields.label: Acetylene Pressure 15 psi
fields.description: Is acetylene pressure suitable (15 psi)?

fields.label: Cylinders Stored Properly
fields.description: Are the gas cylinders used for welding stored in good and suitable conditions?

fields.label: O2/Acetylene Indoors
fields.description: Are oxygen and acetylene cylinders present indoors?

fields.label: Welding Machine Grounded
fields.description: Is the outer body of the electric welding machine connected to the ground?

fields.label: Special Eye Filters PPE
fields.description: Are appropriate PPEs, and in particular eye filters with special filters, depending on the diameter of the electrode?

fields.label: Switch Cutter Nearby
fields.description: Is the switch cutter located near the welding machine for emergency use?

fields.label: Fuse/Circuit Breaker
fields.description: Is there a Fuse or Circuit Breaker?

fields.label: Arc Welding Cables Intact
fields.description: Are the cables used in arc welding operations intact and free of nodes and joints, at least in the last three meters before reaching the electrode?

fields.label: PPE & Safety Rules
fields.description: Are employees adhering to safety rules and wearing PPE during work?

fields.label: Fire Monitor Present
fields.description: Is the fire monitor continuously present during the work?

fields.label: Gas Pressure Monitored
fields.description: Is the gas cylinder pressure monitored?

fields.label: Fire Controller Wait 30 min
fields.description: Ensuring that the fire controller leaves the welding site half an hour after the end of the welding process?

fields.label: Site Inspected
fields.description: Was the work site inspected and the work performed properly?

fields.label: Site Cleaned
fields.description: Was the site cleaned of the effects and products of the welding process?
